statement: Discard the current-engine replay Candidate. It remains Benchmark-compliant, but its incremental current-factory evidence regresses four of five locked cases: steady and mixed production deliver 78 rather than 88 devices, mixed-case average WIP rises from 49.1905 to 52.2903, and score falls 4.13438. The facility-interruption improvement does not justify a mode that systematically damages normal commissioned operation. Keep the mode only as a negative boundary; do not apply it.
